text_block_list.name: Popular Idol
text_block_list.text:
—...3, 2, 1! Happy New Yeeeaaar!! Happy 
New Year, everyone~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Happy New Yeeeaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Fwaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"That was a super! Amazing! Countdown 
live!!"

Brought along by Smart Falcon, I spent New 
Year's Eve at a popular idol's countdown 
concert.

There is no doubt it was a wonderful 
concert, but going non-stop until morning 
left me thoroughly exhausted. Meanwhile, 
she seemed to have gotten energized 
instead—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The reason that idol is so popular was 
packed tightly into today's concert, 
wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Both the singing and dancing were on a 
whole different level of power! My heart 
was completely grabbed and shaken all 
over!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to become such an amazing Umadol 
that people will want to spend New Year's 
Eve with me too!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm definitely gonna be one~☆ I'm 
gonna sing and dance a whole bunch this 
year too♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of course!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My resolution for this year is, naturally, 
nothing other than "Top Umadol"!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna win tons, stand center stage, 
and sparkle even mooore! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Now that we're all recharged, let's keep 
going full idol for the rest of the day☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Searching for the answer as to why idols 
shine so brightly—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Should I go to more idol concerts, do some 
idol image training, or research idols 
more...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Which one do you want!?

...After pulling an all-nighter, any of 
these looks tough, but I want to match her 
enthusiasm. In this case—
choice_data_list:
Sleep! Dream about idols and do image 
training

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer! Falco has 
received your passion loud and clear♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll go look for a live performance we can 
jump in on right now☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna burn bright and fierce~! Yeah!

Afterward, Smart Falcon and I stormed New 
Year's idol lives, from underground stages 
to mainstream venues alike—

She brilliantly managed to enjoy every bit 
of the 24-hour endurance live...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~~~♪ Trainer, let's hit up one more 
scene!
...She was going to show them...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, sleep!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, do you do mental training by 
sleeping?
choice_data_list:
Training your subconscious is what makes a 
true Umadol!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-I don't really get it, but... it feels 
kind of like that!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Falco will show you the perfect 
Umadol, even in your dreams!!

And so, we were able to spend a peaceful 
New Year's without any trouble...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Nice choice♪ How about we hit up a karaoke 
booth?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's saved a ton of idol videos for 
research purposes!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
At karaoke you can play music videos, and 
they have DVDs too. I'll give you tons of 
recommendations!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“—And you know, this group is called the 
technical type, and everyone sings so 
well! So it's really good study. For 
example...”

Afterward, we moved to a spot with a 
screen and enjoyed 'Professor Falco's Idol 
Lecture' for a while.
